home.title: Hi, I'm {name}
home.subtitle: I help you run your AI team from anywhere.
home.signedOut: Sign in from your Chalyb account to continue.

roster.title: Pick your companion
roster.body: Six characters to start with. You can switch whenever you like.

tryon.title: Dress it your way
tryon.body: Outfits and effects from the store. They only change how it looks, never what it can do.

together.title: Shared rooms
together.body: Your companion and your family's or team's, in one room.

recharge.title: When it gets tired, it tells you
recharge.body: If it runs out of energy, the basics keep working: your approvals and alerts. For the rest, you recharge it.

plans.title: Plans
plans.sessions: {n, plural, one {# session at a time} other {# sessions at a time}}

solo.title: Solo Chalito
solo.body: Just the companion, without the rest of Chalyb.

sso.failed: We couldn't open your session. Sign in again from Chalyb.
sso.missingToken: The sign-in link is missing. Sign in from Chalyb.

desktop.title: Open Chalito to finish
desktop.body: You're signed in. Go back to the desktop app to finish signing in.

sso.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then sign in again.
sso.unsolicited: This sign-in link wasn't started from Chalito in this browser, so we didn't use it. To sign in, start here.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: Chalito uses your Chalyb account. No new password needed.

companion.title: Choose your companion
companion.body: You can change it any time. Soon you'll be able to upload your own image or model.

name.title: Name it
name.body: If you rename it, we show the credit line underneath.

connect.title: Connect your AIs
connect.body: We only use each provider's official options. Your keys stay on your computer.
connect.expertBody: Paste your API keys in the desktop app or with "chalito keys set". We never send them to the cloud.
connect.later: You can connect them later in Settings → Connections.

billing.title: How you pay
billing.body: Your plan and credits come from your Chalyb account.
billing.byo: Your own keys: what you use is billed by each provider to your account.
billing.energy: Chalito energy: drawn from your Chalyb balance.
billing.both: Both: your keys first, energy when needed.
billing.tierUnknown: We don't know your Chalyb tier yet.

phone.title: Your phone
phone.body: For WhatsApp messages and calls when something is urgent. Optional.

pair.title: Connect your computer
pair.body: Install Chalito on your computer and pair it with the Chalito glyph.

passkey.title: Protect your approvals
passkey.body: High-risk actions ask for your passkey.

settings.title: Settings

phone.label: Phone
phone.invalid: That number doesn't look valid for the chosen country.
phone.willSend: We'll text you a code to verify it.
phone.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
phone.error: We couldn't verify the number. Try again later.
phone.willCall: We'll call you with a code.
phone.inUse: That number is already on another account.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp alerts
whatsapp.hint: We message you when something needs your attention.

calls.label: Calls
calls.hint: We call you if something is urgent and you don't respond.

callBriefing.label: Call briefing
callBriefing.hint: On a call we read you one line per pending item.
callBriefing.plaintext: Those lines leave your computer unencrypted so they can be read aloud.

quietHours.label: Quiet hours
quietHours.hint: No calls or messages during these hours, except emergencies.

privacyMode.label: Private mode
privacyMode.hint: Use your own keys from your device and store only encrypted content.

connections.label: Connections
connections.none: You haven't connected any AI yet.

settings.needsAck: First confirm you understand that charges may apply.
settings.chargesAck: I understand that charges may apply.

rooms.sealed: Can't be read on this device (missing the room key).
rooms.composer: Write a notice for the room
rooms.attach: Attach this message's text to the report. Only you can read it: Chalito doesn't see room content unless you send it.

ended.kicked: You're no longer a member of this room.
ended.revoked: This device was removed from your account.
ended.not_member: You're no longer a member of this room.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.intro: Private rooms with other families or teams. Messages are end-to-end encrypted: Chalito can't read them.
rooms.none: You're not in any room yet.
rooms.leaveConfirm: Leave the room? You won't see its new messages.
rooms.noKey: Waiting for the room key: another member shares it with this device.
rooms.notFound: We couldn't find this room, or you're no longer a member.

error.not_member: You're no longer a member of this room.
error.rate_limited: Too many reports in a row; wait a moment.
error.bad_code: That code isn't valid or was already used.
error.no_key: You don't have the room key yet.
error.ended: This room has ended for you.
error.not_owner: Only the person who created the room can do this.
error.conflict: The room changed in the meantime. Try again.
error.unsupported: This device can't do that yet.

rooms.removeConfirm: Remove {member}? They won't see new messages.

error.limit: Your plan doesn't allow more rooms.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries; wait a moment.
error.no_devices: This device isn't ready to create rooms.
error.failed: We couldn't create the room. Try again.

invite.how: Have the other person scan the glyph or type this code in Rooms → Join with a code. It works once.

rotation.why: Someone left the room. To keep writing, change the key: whoever left can't read anything new.

dissolve.confirm: Dissolve the room? Its messages, members and invites are deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.

anthropic.name: Claude
anthropic.howTo: Claude Code connects only with your Anthropic API key. Anthropic's rules don't let us use your Claude subscription.

openai.name: ChatGPT
openai.howTo: Codex works with your OpenAI API key or your ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT). The ChatGPT plan is available only to the Chalito team for now.
openai.ownerOnly: ChatGPT plan: Chalito team only for now

xai.name: Grok
xai.howTo: Grok Build works with your xAI API key or your Grok login.

google.name: Gemini
google.howTo: Use your Google AI Studio API key.

pwa.description: Your companion that runs your AI team.

live.testMode: TEST MODE: simulated data, nothing is real.

gate.signed_out: Sign in with your Chalyb account to see your sessions and approvals.
gate.unpaired: This browser isn't trusted yet. Approve it from a trusted device or pair it from the desktop app.
gate.error: We couldn't connect. Try again in a moment.
gate.revoked: This device was removed from your account. Pair it again from a trusted device.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.body: This is a {risk}-risk action. Confirm with your fingerprint, face or security key.

approval.sealed: The details are encrypted for another device.
approval.stepUpNeeded: Approving asks for your fingerprint, face or security key.

error.unverified_request: Can't approve: the request isn't verified.

approval.needsPasskey: To approve high-risk actions, protect this device with your passkey.
approval.hiddenChars: Contains invisible characters that can change how the text looks; they're shown here as ⟦U+…⟧.
approval.mustExpand: The summary is cut: open the full content before approving.
approval.unverifiedNote: Your computer didn't sign this request, or it doesn't match what it signed. It can't be approved; you can deny it.

session.sealed: The card is encrypted for another device.
session.untrusted: That computer isn't paired with this device.

devices.title: Devices
devices.devModeOffSent: Done: asked to turn it off.
devices.revokeConfirm: Remove {name}? It won't be able to approve anything.

notices.title: Security notices
notices.missingStepUp: {computer} refused a new device because the approval didn't include your passkey. Approve it again with your passkey.
notices.refused: {computer} refused a new device: the approval wasn't valid. Approve it again.

devices.revokeFailed: We couldn't revoke it. Nothing changed; try again.
devices.revokedServer: {name} was revoked: it can no longer sign in to your account or send anything to your computers.
devices.revokeAgentOffline: {agent}: offline. Its access is already closed on the server, and {agent} will drop it from its list as soon as it reconnects.

everywhere.title: Sign out of every other device
everywhere.body: If you lost a phone or think someone got into your account: every other phone and browser is cut off at once. Your computers stay paired.
everywhere.needsPasskey: To use this, first create a passkey on this device.
everywhere.confirm: Sign out every other phone and browser? We'll ask for your passkey.
everywhere.done: {n, plural, =0 {There were no other devices.} one {Signed out # device.} other {Signed out # devices.}}
everywhere.agentOffline: {agent}: offline; it will remove them as soon as it reconnects.
everywhere.agentUntrusted: {agent}: doesn't trust this device, so it didn't get the notice. Their access is already closed on the server.
everywhere.banFailed: Some sign-outs will take a moment longer.

error.no_passkey: This needs your passkey on this device.
error.failed: That didn't work. Nothing changed; try again.

settings.server: Your settings are saved to your account.
settings.device: Sign in to save your settings; for now they're kept on this device.

error.rejected: Couldn't save: verify your phone and confirm that charges may apply first.
error.failed: We couldn't save that change. Try again.
error.charges_notice_required: First confirm you understand that charges may apply.
error.country_not_supported: Calls to this country aren't available.

notification.notFound: That alert no longer exists or isn't yours.

passkey.title: Protect your approvals with your passkey
passkey.body: To approve high or critical risk actions from here, we'll ask for your fingerprint, face or security key. Your computer verifies it.
passkey.afterPairing: Once you pair your computer, we'll ask you to create a passkey on this device.
passkey.cancelled: You cancelled the passkey; you can try again.
passkey.error: We couldn't create the passkey. Try again.
passkey.replaceRefused: To change your passkey, confirm with the current one first. Lost it? Add this device again.
passkey.replaced: Done: your new passkey protects your approvals.

push.title: Notifications
push.hint: Alerts on this device when something needs you. They only say what kind of alert it is; you see the details when you open it.
push.enable: Turn on alerts on this device
push.on: Alerts are on for this device.
push.denied: You blocked alerts for this site. Turn them on in your browser's settings.
push.unsupported: This browser can't get alerts here.
push.needsPairing: Link this browser to get alerts on it.
push.failed: We couldn't turn alerts on. Try again.

notification.title: Chalito
notification.approval: An approval is waiting for you.
notification.expired: An approval expired: it was denied.

newSession.title: New session
newSession.offlineNote: That computer is offline. The session starts when it's back, if that's within a few minutes.
newSession.workspaceHint: The name of a folder you allowed on that computer. Chalito never sees its paths.
newSession.waiting: Sent. Waiting for your computer to start it…
newSession.timeout: Your computer didn't start it. Check that it's on, that the workspace exists and that the agent is turned on there.
newSession.untrusted: This computer isn't paired with this device.
newSession.noComputers: You don't have a linked computer yet.

account.title: Delete my Chalito account
account.explain: Deletes your Chalito companions, sessions, devices and settings. Your Chalyb account doesn't change.
account.needsPairing: To ask for this, link this browser as a device.
account.needsPasskey: To ask for this, this device needs a passkey.

what.data: Your Chalito data is deleted: companions, sessions, devices, rooms and settings.
what.grace: You have 7 days to cancel. After that it can't be undone.
what.export: First we prepare a copy of your data for you to download.
what.hub: Your Chalyb account, plan and credits don't change.

account.ack: I understand this deletes my Chalito account.
account.scheduled: Your Chalito account will be deleted on {date}.
account.countdown: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} left to cancel.
account.loadFailed: We couldn't check your account. Try again later.

note.cancelled_step_up: The passkey wasn't confirmed; nothing was requested.
note.passkey_required: This device needs a passkey to ask for this.
note.step_up_failed: The passkey couldn't be verified. Try again.
note.failed: We couldn't do it. Try again.
note.cancelled: Done: your account won't be deleted.
note.export_failed: We couldn't download your data. Try again.

consent.title: {client} wants to connect to Chalito
consent.gone: That request no longer exists or expired. Connect again from the app.

error.passkey_failed: We couldn't confirm with your passkey.
error.challenge_expired: That took too long; try again.

consent.badRedirect: The return address isn't safe; we won't send you there.
consent.needsDevice: To allow it, open this page on a paired device.
consent.needsPasskey: Allowing it asks for your passkey.

connectors.title: Connected apps
connectors.failed: We couldn't load your connected apps.
connectors.signedOut: Sign in to see your connected apps.

sharing.label: Share card with connected apps
sharing.warning: The card (goal, state and last action) will be stored unencrypted so your connected apps can read it.

wait.title: Use this browser
wait.body: To see and approve your sessions here, a device you already trust has to approve this browser.
wait.signInFirst: First sign in with your Chalyb account in this browser.
wait.unavailable: This browser can't be added right now. Try again in a moment.
wait.waitingBody: On your phone or another trusted browser, open Devices → Add a device and scan this ring or type the code.
wait.glyphLabel: Ring to scan from a trusted device
wait.whereToApprove: Before approving, check the fingerprint is the same on both devices.
wait.doneBody: This browser is now trusted. To send instructions to a computer, pair it with that computer too.

error.expired: The code expired. Show a new one.
error.unavailable: This browser can't be added right now. Try again in a moment.
error.endorsement_mismatch: The approval isn't for this browser. Try again.
error.endorser_not_trusted: The device that approved is no longer trusted.
error.device_exists: This browser was already registered. Show a new code.
error.rejected: The approval wasn't accepted. Try again.

wait.doneIntroduced: You can send instructions to {computers} right away: your other device introduced them.
wait.doneDropped: {computer}: we couldn't confirm it. Pair it with its ring to send it instructions.

add.title: Add a device
add.body: On the new device, sign in to your account and open “Use this browser”. Then scan its ring or type its code.

scan.scanning: Point the camera at the ring.
scan.denied: No permission to use the camera. Type the code.
scan.unavailable: The camera isn't available. Type the code.

add.compare: Check this fingerprint matches the one on the new device:
add.withPasskey: We'll ask for your passkey when you approve.
add.withoutPasskey: That device will be able to approve actions just like this one.

error.invalid_code: That code isn't valid. Check it.
error.not_found: We couldn't find that code. Check it or show a new one.
error.expired: The code expired. Show a new one on the other device.
error.wrong_account: That device belongs to another account.
error.step_up: Your passkey is needed to approve. Try again.
error.not_trusted: This device is no longer trusted.
error.tampered: The details don't match. Don't approve it; show a new code.
error.passkey_cloned: Your passkey looks copied, so nothing was approved. Check your devices and create a new passkey.

usage.empty: No usage in this period yet.

byo.title: Your keys
byo.body: Usage with your own provider keys. It uses no Chalito tokens.
byo.chartLabel: Tokens with your keys per day, last {days} days

store.title: Store
store.intro: Outfits and effects for your companion. They only change how it looks, never what it can do.
store.signIn: Sign in with your Chalyb account to see the store.
store.noCompanion: You don't have a companion yet.
store.retryBuy: The purchase didn't go through. Retrying never charges twice.
store.failed: Couldn't buy it. Try again later.
store.lookOnly: Accessories don't change what your companion can do or its limits.

legal.draftBody: A lawyer hasn't reviewed this text yet and it may change. It isn't the final version.
legal.onboarding: By continuing you accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.signedOut: Sign in with your Chalyb account to see your plan.
plan.fromHub: Your plan and credits come from your Chalyb account.

how.title: How they work
how.tokens: What Chalito does for you (work and alerts) spends tokens from your Chalyb account.
how.byo: Anything that runs on your own AI keys doesn't spend Chalito tokens.
how.basics: If you run out, the basics keep working: your approvals and alerts.
how.recharge: You recharge on Chalyb and the new tokens work here right away.
